defensives.name: Aspect of the Turtle
defensives.usage_rule: Press to gain full immunity to all damage and crowd control during a lethal mechanic; note that it disarms you so it stops your own casting for its duration.

defensives.name: Survival of the Fittest
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively ahead of a predictable damage spike for a strong flat damage reduction.

defensives.name: Exhilaration
defensives.usage_rule: Press when health drops below roughly 50% to instantly restore a meaningful chunk of your maximum health between damage events.
